issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named `_detect_errors(...)` (leading underscore) while the template (and the solution) provides/implements a function named `detect_errors(...)` (no underscore). This naming mismatch is structural: students following the problem text will implement `_detect_errors`, but the template/tests expect `detect_errors` (or vice-versa), causing confusion and likely failing tests or grader checks.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the function name consistent across all artifacts. Either (a) change the problem statement and any tests to refer to `detect_errors(...)` (no leading underscore), or (b) rename the template and solution function to `_detect_errors(...)`. Prefer option (a) to match the existing template and solution naming and reduce surprise for students.
